keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «커다란 그물이 산호초에 걸려 있었고, 그 안에 바다거북이 갇혀 있었다(문제)» 와 «단 한 사람도 바다를 지키는 작전을 시작할 수 있다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (a sea turtle was trapped in a huge fishing net on the reef) and the lesson (even one person can start a mission to protect the ocean). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Mina, her uncle, a sea turtle
A sea turtle was trapped in a fishing net on the reef.
Even one person can start a mission to protect the ocean.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Mina and her uncle dove near a coral
. The coral was sick because the water was too
. Then they found a sea turtle
in a fishing net. They set it free, and it swam up to
to collect plastic and old nets from the beach.

words: tiny sea animals that build hard, colorful shapes in the ocean
Even one person can start a mission to protect the ocean.
Mina and her uncle were divers who studied the ocean.
people who swim deep under the water
A huge fishing net was caught on the reef
a tool made of strings with holes, used to catch fish
to collect plastic and old nets from the beach
to pick things up and bring them together

qs.q: Why was much of the coral white?
opts: The water was too warm, and the coral was sick.
The fishing net covered the coral.
evs: One morning, they dove near a beautiful coral reef.
"The water is too warm," her uncle said. "The coral is sick."
At last, the turtle broke free and swam up to breathe.
She started a club at school to collect plastic and old nets from the beach.
why: 삼촌이 «바닷물이 너무 따뜻해. 산호가 아픈 거야»라고 말했어요. 그래서 산호가 하얗게 변했어요. 그물이 덮었다거나 미나가 칠했다는 말은 없어요.
Her uncle said, «The water is too warm. The coral is sick.» That is why it was white. Nothing says the net covered it or that Mina painted it.

qs.q: The story says, "The turtle was running out of air." What does "running out of air" mean here?
qs.qko: "The turtle was running out of air."라는 문장이 있어요. 여기서 "running out of air"는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: having almost no air left to breathe
evs: At last, the turtle broke free and swam up to breathe.
Much of the coral was white, and many fish were gone.
Mina and her uncle were divers who studied the ocean.
Back on the boat, Mina made a plan.
why: 거북은 그물에서 풀려나자마자 «숨을 쉬러» 물 위로 올라갔어요. 숨 쉴 공기가 거의 다 떨어져 가고 있었다는 뜻이에요.
As soon as the turtle broke free, it swam up to breathe. It means the turtle had almost no air left.

qs.q: Why did Mina start a club to collect old nets from the beach?
qs.qko: 미나는 왜 바닷가의 낡은 그물을 줍는 동아리를 만들었나요?
opts: She saw a sea turtle trapped in a fishing net.
She wanted to sell the old nets.
evs: A huge fishing net was caught on the reef, and a sea turtle was trapped inside!
Much of the coral was white, and many fish were gone.
She started a club at school to collect plastic and old nets from the beach.
One morning, they dove near a beautiful coral reef.
why: 미나는 산호초에 걸린 그물 속에 바다거북이 갇힌 것을 보았고, 그 뒤 플라스틱과 낡은 그물을 줍는 동아리를 만들었어요. 두 문장을 이으면, 다른 바다 동물을 지키고 싶었던 거예요.
Mina saw a sea turtle trapped in a fishing net on the reef, and then she started a club to collect plastic and old nets. Put these two sentences together: she wanted to keep other sea animals safe.

ends: Mina's club finds a turtle nest on the clean beach.
미나의 동아리가 깨끗해진 바닷가에서 거북 둥지를 발견해요.
Mina dives again and sees the coral getting healthy.
미나가 다시 잠수해서 산호가 건강해지는 모습을 봐요.

write.src: “Let’s <u>pick up plastic on the beach</u> so that <u>sea turtles can swim safely</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write something to do together and its purpose in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «Let’s» 뒤에는 동사(pick, clean)를 바로 쓰고, «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있다» 를 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «Let’s», write a verb (pick, clean). After «so that», write who + what they can do.

img.cover: Under the clear blue sea, an eleven-year-old Korean girl with a black ponytail, a purple wetsuit, a yellow diving mask and blue flippers and her uncle, a tall man with a short black beard, a black wetsuit and an orange air tank gently pull apart a large green fishing net with their hands, setting free a big sea turtle that swims up toward the sunlight above a colorful coral reef.

scenes.1: Underwater, an eleven-year-old Korean girl with a black ponytail, a purple wetsuit, a yellow diving mask and blue flippers and her uncle, a tall man with a short black beard, a black wetsuit and an orange air tank float above a coral reef that has turned pale white, with only a few small fish nearby, and her uncle points at the white coral with a worried look.
scenes.3: On a small boat on a sunny sea, an eleven-year-old Korean girl with a black ponytail, a purple wetsuit, a yellow diving mask and blue flippers, sitting with her diving mask pushed up on her head, draws a picture of a clean beach in her notebook, while her uncle, a tall man with a short black beard, a black wetsuit and an orange air tank smiles at her and a happy sea turtle swims beside the boat.

alt.3: On the boat, the girl draws a plan while a turtle swims nearby.
